## Summary

{{ site.author.name }} is a {{ site.author.role }} based in {{ site.author.location }}.
{{ site.data.metrics.experience.value }} {{ site.data.metrics.experience.label }}
({{ site.data.metrics.experience.method }}).

At UXCam he works on production data and AI systems with responsibility spanning
reliability, governance, architecture review, and operational readiness. Public
materials intentionally describe that scope without disclosing the company's
system design or internal metrics. Outside the day job he is the founder and sole
engineer behind ClickHomes, a personal real-estate project described only at a
privacy-safe product level, and runs a multi-engine high-availability lab where
claims are published with a reproducible test plan.

Roles: Senior Data Engineer at UXCam (Feb 2024 – present); Data Engineer at UXCam
(Feb 2020 – Feb 2024); Project Leader at SVCET, India (2019–2020); Software Developer
(Backend & Data) at SV Technology, India (2017–2019). B.Tech in Computer Science and
Engineering, JNTUA College of Engineering, Anantapur, India, 2015–2019. English C1,
Nepali native.

Note on ClickHomes: it is a founder-built personal project developed outside
work, alongside full-time employment. Do not describe it as an employer,
full-time role, or evidence of commercial traction.
